callee.opaque: what the callee computes from (query, index) is not pinned

landing_pad: none: no landing-pad entry inside the routine FDE range; the routine has no exception cleanup block
not_claimed: what the callee at 0x5d8ce30 computes from (query, index)
what the object, the +0xd10 array, or the +0xd08 default slot denote
caller semantics beyond the site and FDE range

behaviour on dangling pointers, a null object pointer (the routine reads +0xd10/+0xd08 on the miss paths, so the model raises on a null object), or an out-of-range index (the binary reads past the array unchecked; the model raises instead)

routine.returns: one pointer: the callee result, the array entry, or the default slot value

stages.name: callee
stages.result: non-null callee result returned at once; nothing else read

stages.name: array
stages.result: entry [index] of the pointer array at object +0xd10, 8-byte stride; non-null entry returned

stages.name: default
stages.result: the pointer at object +0xd08, returned whatever it is, including null

trailing_bytes: bytes after the FDE range, 0x5d52ba9..0x5d52bb0, are int3 padding, not a landing-pad block
